description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Forgiven, Light spell-like ability, sufficiently high level and Charisma (see feat description)

Benefit: You gain one additional use per day of daylight. Choose one spell from the table below; by expending a use of daylight, you may use this spell as a spell-like ability. To select a spell, you must meet the minimum character level and Charisma score for its listing in the table. The save DC for this spell is Charisma-based.

system.requirements: Forgiven, Light spell-like ability, sufficiently high level and Charisma (see feat description)
